hints.title: Frequency Counting
hints.text: Count the occurrences of every character appearing in the string.

hints.title: Separating Parities
hints.text: Partition the non-zero frequencies into odd and even categories.

hints.title: Extrema Identification
hints.text: Subtract the minimum even frequency from the maximum odd frequency to maximize the difference.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Counts letter frequencies in an array of size 26 and finds extreme values in a single pass.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeated scans over the string for each character would introduce unnecessary overhead.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Fixed alphabet size of 26 uses constant auxiliary memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies hash map or fixed array to isolate odd and even frequencies cleanly.
